description: This Java source file defines the class 'MockBridgeCluster' which simulates a network bridge device in a Zigbee testing framework. The class manages commands related to bridge refresh and tampering, handles event notifications, and maintains internal state such as tamper status. It implements the 'Tamperable' interface and extends 'MockCluster', providing hooks for external listeners and event generation.

classes.name: MockBridgeCluster
classes.description: A mock class simulating a Zigbee bridge device, handling specific manufacturer commands, event notifications, tamper state, and providing listener management.

classes.name: BridgeListener
classes.description: An interface for objects that wish to be notified of refresh requests from the bridge.

methods.name: MockBridgeCluster
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bridge mock with a unique identifier and endpoint.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Processes manufacturer-specific commands such as refresh and reset, triggering events and listener notifications.

methods.name: addBridgeListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to the bridge events.

methods.name: removeBridgeListener
methods.description: Deregisters a listener from the bridge events.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns whether the bridge is currently tampered.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tamper status of the bridge and triggers an alarm event if the state changes.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Overrides attribute data setting; currently always returns success.
